q: for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

q: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes?

q: They have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

q: Why then have the people of Jerusalem fallen back by a perpetual backsliding? They cling to deceit. They refuse to return.

q: Isn’t the LORD in Zion? Isn’t her King in her?

q: They will not be gathered or be buried. They will be like dung on the surface of the earth.

q: from the prophet even to the priest everyone deals falsely.

s: idols and engraved images provokes the LORD (to anger)

q: but my people don’t know the LORD’s law.

q: For everyone from the least even to the greatest is given to covetousness

s: people of Judah and Jerusalem is unashamed of abomination (cannot blush)
q: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush.

s: the LORD has title LORD of Armies
q: says the LORD of Armies.

s: the LORD has law the LORD's law (people do not know it)
q: my people don’t know the LORD’s law.

s: the LORD will cause judgment and destruction (utterly consume them; no grapes or figs)
q: I will utterly consume them, says the LORD. No grapes will be on the vine, no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf will fade.

q: but my people don’t know the LORD’s law.

s: the LORD is a LORD of Armies (title)
q: Therefore the LORD of Armies says,

q: They have taught their tongue to speak lies.

s: the daughter of my people forsakes the LORD's law (did not obey or walk in his ways)
q: Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice or walked in my ways,

s: the daughter of my people follows Baal (taught by their fathers)
q: but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them.”

s: Jeremiah mourns for the daughter of my people (weeps day and night for the slain)
q: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

s: Jeremiah desires a wilderness lodging (to leave his people)
q: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men, that I might leave my people and go from them!

s: Jerusalem will become heaps (dwelling place of jackals, by the LORD)
q: “I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals.

s: Judah will become desolation (cities without inhabitant)
q: I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”

s: coming judgment and desolation includes scattering among the nations (sword sent until consumed)
q: I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known. I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.”

s: coming judgment and desolation includes wormwood and poisoned water (food and drink for the people)
q: I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.

s: coming judgment and desolation includes unburied dead (fall as dung, no one gathers)
q: The dead bodies of men will fall as dung on the open field, and as the handful after the harvester. No one will gather them.

s: the LORD is a God of Israel (title)
q: Therefore the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says,

s: Egypt is a uncircumcised nation (circumcised only in flesh, to be punished)
q: Egypt, Judah, Edom, the children of Ammon, Moab, and all who have the corners of their hair cut off, who dwell in the wilderness, for all the nations are uncircumcised

s: jackals dwell in Jerusalem (after it becomes heaps)
q: I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals.

s: the LORD exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness (on the earth)
q: that I am the LORD who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness on the earth

q: for I delight in these things,” says the LORD.

s: Israel is a uncircumcised in heart (all the house of Israel)
q: all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.”

q: For they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

q: Friends deceive each other, and will not speak the truth.
